name: Away From Home
source:
The story starts when your father, who is an ex-cop, tells you to go stay with your aunt Eva, without giving any reason. You're uncomfortable with the arrangement, but your mom has already prepared everything for the trip, and you two hit the road.

Old friends, new friends, new adventures await you there. While you try to adjust to your new life, you also try to figure out why your father sent you this far away.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/vatosgames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事始于你的父亲——一名前警察——在没有说明原因的情况下，要求你去和姨妈Eva一起住。你对这个安排感到不安，但母亲已经准备好旅程所需的一切，于是你们上路了。

等待你的有老朋友、新朋友与全新冒险。你一边适应新生活，一边试图弄清父亲为何把你送到这么远的地方。

[编辑自[url=https://www.patreon.com/vatosgames]Patreon[/url]]
